verdicts.reason: Both look almost the same, and both are broken. The wind-turbine icon, which was the hero, is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail and squeezed into a jumbled strip at the left with the green, blue and red triangles. The right third is left empty apart from a few stray hairlines, so the banner is lopsided. A is slightly better because its headline is a bit larger and has more space from the red triangle. In B the text sits right against the triangle's edge.
